title: Research home, search thread, library, activity and settings
description: Unified composer home, search results as a research thread of paper cards with saved state, library with dropzone and URL filter, readable activity with paper links and retry, polished settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given the home composer, when a topic is submitted, then the query is recorded in search history and results render as paper cards with title, authors, year, abstract and links.
Given a result already in the library, then the card shows In library with Open; saving another result shows Saved to library without duplicating.
Given a library paper chosen as composer context, when a question is submitted, then the paper workspace opens on a new chat and streams the answer.
Given a failed ingest job, when Retry processing is pressed on Activity, then the job is queued again and links to its paper.
test_cases: research RTL: save, rate limit, saved flag
library RTL: filter in URL, upload dropzone validation
